name: Wolt Storefront SDK
author: Wolt Storefront Team

sections.description:
Give your customers a faster and easier way to place orders — right from your website.

The Wolt Storefront SDK plugin adds a clear, high-visibility “Order Now” button or widget that connects directly to your Storefront page.
It helps customers take action immediately, improving conversion rates and increasing your online sales, all with just a few minutes of setup.

About Wolt Storefront

Wolt Storefront turns your website into a seamless, branded online ordering platform that helps you grow profits and drive more direct sales.

You’ll need to have Wolt Storefront set up before using this plugin.
If you’re not yet using Storefront or would like to learn more, visit the Wolt Storefront product page to get started.

Why it matters

  • Boost online sales – Prominent “Order Now” buttons lead to more clicks and more orders.
  • Go live faster – No developers needed. Setup takes about 5 minutes.
  • Automatic updates – When you update your Storefront settings or promotions, they appear instantly on your site.
  • Foundation for growth – Future versions can show special offers or seasonal campaigns inside the same widget.

What It Does

The Wolt Storefront SDK plugin securely adds a lightweight script to your site’s HTML so that your “Order Now” button or widget appears automatically — always in sync with your Storefront settings.

Highlights:

  • Adds your Storefront SDK code securely into your site.
  • Instantly syncs Storefront settings from the Merchant Admin tool to your site.
  • Only allows scripts from trusted Storefront domains.
  • Loads fast with automatic preconnect optimization.
sections.installation:
Step 1 – Install the Plugin

  1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New and search for “Wolt Storefront SDK”.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Step 2 – Paste Your Storefront Script

  1. Go to Settings → Wolt Storefront SDK.
  2. Copy the script provided in your Wolt Merchant Admin tool and paste it into the box.
  3. Click Save Changes.

Step 3 – That’s It 🎉

Your website now displays your “Order Now” button or widget, connected directly to your Storefront page so customers can start ordering right away.
sections.faq:
Do I need any technical skills?

No. Just copy and paste the script from your Merchant Admin tool — the plugin handles everything else.

How does this help my sales?

Customers see the “Order Now” button immediately instead of hunting through menus.
When it’s easier to find, more visitors place an order — boosting your online sales.

How long does setup take?

Usually about 5 minutes from start to finish.

Will it update automatically?

Yes. Any updates in your Storefront configuration or promotions appear in real time on your website.

Is it safe?

Absolutely. The plugin only accepts HTTPS scripts from official Storefront domains and removes any unsafe code automatically.

Does this plugin collect any personal data?

No. The plugin itself doesn’t collect any personal data from you or your visitors.

When customers click the “Order Now” button and are redirected to your Wolt Storefront page, basic tracking is applied only to measure visits originating from your site — the SDK itself does not store or process any personal data.
